APPROVE

The nested `foreach`/`if`/`continue` block (which carried most of the cognitive complexity) is replaced by an equivalent eager LINQ pipeline in a helper. The same filter, the same `CtorFqn.Length > 0` check and the same ordinal-comparer `HashSet<string>` are kept, and the file already uses LINQ (`Any`), so it should build cleanly. I reviewed the diff only and did not build it.
